posts.name: Praion
posts.cooked:
How do these combinations play out? They are thematic yeah but do they make good makes? 

#1 The base game reloaded 
Vengeance Five: Baron Blade + Citizens Hammer and Anvil + Greazer Clutch/Biomancer fighting at Omnitron IV 

This is supposed to recapture the 4 villains from the original game. I chose GC/Bio as replacements for Voss because one is an alien and the other deals with minions. Which would fit better? 

 

#2 A night in Rook City 
Ermine + Plague Rat + Operative in Rook City 

Is there anyone else from RC? 

 

#3 All the expansions 
Vengeance Five: Baron Blade + Plague Rat/Operative + Bugbear + La Capitan + Greazer Clutch in one of the Oblivaeon Environments

Baron Blade represents the base game + Vengeance. PR/O present Rook City. Bugbear reperesents Infernal Relics. LC is for Shattered Timelines and GC for Wrath of the Cosmos. Of course all villains from villains represent villains. 

 

#4 Regular People 
Ambuscade + Ermine + Sergeant Steel + maybe the Operative in ??? maybe the film studios? 

Represents just pretty regular people without huge powers or anything like that. They should probably be fought by Mr. Fixer and Expatriete and The Wraith or something like that. 

What are other fun combinations that you have found - especially gameplay wise?
